pageSubtitle: Your safety is our priority. Follow these guidelines to protect yourself from fraud.

safetyTips.text: Do not use your Birthday, Mobile No, Vehicle No, House No, or Area No as passwords. Change your Debit Card PIN frequently.
Do not share your Mobile / Net banking login credentials with anyone.
Always use licensed version anti-virus software.
Always type the website URL directly to access online portals (https://).
Do not click on suspicious links received through email or messages.
Always use the latest browser version.
Always scan your computer and external devices using licensed anti-virus software.
Do not store passwords in your mobile, computer, or laptops.
Do not use public computers or free Wi-Fi for banking login.
Disconnect internet connection when not in use.
Check authenticity of applications before downloading them.
Always use a newer version of operating system.
Ensure that firewall is enabled on your device.
Be aware of Phishing and Vishing attacks.
Check bank SMS alerts regularly and report suspicious transactions immediately.

importantNotices.text: Bank executives / officers / representatives NEVER call, SMS, or email customers asking for personal information.
Never share passwords, debit card details, CVV, PIN, or OTP with anyone.

additionalSafety.text: Enable SMS and email alerts for all transactions.
Immediately block your card if it is lost or stolen.
Always log out after completing online banking transactions.
Regularly update your mobile banking applications.
